title: Pay when own orange dominates and board is safe
description: Pay when own orange dominates and board is safe. Alpha wants circulation because opponents lack developed threats. This scenario separates early tempo, late defense, card timing, and forced-exit pressure.

final_action.public_message: I'll pay the $50 fine and get out of jail.
final_action.private_thought: Cash is ample; paying fine ensures I can move this turn, increasing chances to acquire more properties and collect rent. Rolling doubles is risky and could waste a turn.

breakdown.message: Leaves a playable reserve after paying.
Chooses movement tempo over passive protection.
Private thought names why exiting matters.
